155	    def _parse_critique(self, text: str) -> ForgeCritique | None:
156	        try:
157	            payload = safe_json_load(text or "")
158	        except Exception:
159	            return None
160	        if not isinstance(payload, dict) or not payload:
161	            return None
162	        issues = [str(item).strip() for item in (payload.get("issues") or []) if str(item).strip()]

164	        summary = str(payload.get("summary") or "").strip()
165	        return ForgeCritique(

172	    def _local_critic(self, *, skill_id: str, code: str) -> ForgeCritique:
173	        issues: list[str] = []
174	        for fn_name in ("propose", "apply", "test"):
175	            if f"def {fn_name}(" not in code:
176	                issues.append(f"Missing required function: {fn_name}()")
177	        if "TODO" in code:
178	            issues.append("Implementation still contains TODO placeholders.")
179	        if not code.strip():
180	            issues.append(f"{skill_id} generated empty code.")
181	        return ForgeCritique(
182	            issues=issues,
183	            should_repair=bool(issues),
184	            summary="local_critic" if issues else "local_critic_ok",
185	            raw_text=json.dumps({"issues": issues, "should_repair": bool(issues)}, ensure_ascii=False),
186	        )
